## Contact
This is JubAp.US’s virtual storefront and published contact address. For an integration or value-creation mandate, contact us by email with the context and scope of your request.

For a corpus enquiry, identify the relevant document, version and question so its context can be retained. The legal notice provides the site’s publishing identity and the privacy notice its data-handling information. This helps route the enquiry without treating related initiatives as interchangeable owners of a claim or mandate.
